options.name: LC_HVDBT
options.meaning: Run the guest's 64-bit code in the hypervisor engine, with TCG as its other half. Needs a QEMU configured with -Dhvdbt_engine. Apple silicon only.

options.name: VIM_PASSTHROUGH_OPENGL_INPROCESS_LIBRARY
options.meaning: The OpenGL host library QEMU loads into its own process.

options.name: VIM_PASSTHROUGH_OPENGL_INLINE
options.meaning: Have the in-process OpenGL host serve inline.

options.name: VIM_PASSTHROUGH_OPENGL_SURFACE_IMPORT
options.meaning: Let the OpenGL host import guest surfaces directly.

options.name: VIM_DISPLAY_EVENT_DRIVEN
options.meaning: Scan the display out on events rather than on a poll.

options.name: VIM_OPENGL_VRAM_SERVICE
options.meaning: The service name QEMU exports guest VRAM under.

options.name: VIM_OPENGL_VRAM_ENDPOINT
options.meaning: Where the OpenGL host publishes its VRAM endpoint.

options.name: VIM_OPENGL_DISPLAY_ENDPOINT
options.meaning: Where the OpenGL host publishes its display endpoint.

options.name: VIM_AUDIO_OUTPUT_DEVICE
options.meaning: The SDL output device. A named device that's missing fails rather than rerouting.

options.name: VIM_AUDIO_INPUT_DEVICE
options.meaning: The SDL input device. A named device that's missing fails rather than rerouting.

options.name: VIM_INPUT_BACKPRESSURE
options.meaning: Refuse a whole input batch before dispatch when the guest can't take it, so the app can retry it without duplicates.

options.name: VIM_E1000_LINK_HISTORY
options.meaning: Record the e1000's link history, for --record-network-history.

options.name: VIM_INSTALLER_DISPLAY_SOCKET
options.meaning: The app's socket for the installer display.

options.name: VIM_DISPLAY_REFRESH_MS
options.meaning: The installer display's poll interval, in milliseconds.

options.name: PVG_OOP_HELPER
options.meaning: The out-of-process PVG helper. Apple silicon only.

options.name: PVG_OOP_DONOR
options.meaning: The donor ParavirtualizedGraphics framework the helper loads.

options.name: PVG_APP_DISPLAY_SOCKET
options.meaning: The app's socket for the PVG display.

options.name: PVG_OOP_SCALE_FACTOR
options.meaning: The helper's panel scale: 1 or 2, and anything else stops the helper.

options.name: PVG_APP_DISPLAY_SCALE
options.meaning: The panel is Retina when this is 2. A capability, not the current mode.

options.name: PVG_PRESERVE_IOSURFACE
options.meaning: Preserve IOSurface contents for the legacy shadow.

options.name: PVG_SHADOW_COALESCE
options.meaning: Coalesce the legacy shadow's page copies.

options.name: PVG_SHADOW_MAX_CHUNK
options.meaning: The largest coalesced copy: a power of two from 4096 to 1048576.

options.name: PVG_SHADOW_TEXTURE_PAGING
options.meaning: Hook texture paging in the legacy shadow.

options.name: PVG_TEST_MSAA_TRANSFER
options.meaning: The ordered transfer for packed multisample depth/stencil. Intel only, despite the name.

options.name: PVG_HOST_AIR_LLVM
options.meaning: The LLVM library for Mojave's host AIR shader repair.

testingFlags.name: LC_HVDBT_TALLY
testingFlags.meaning: Where the engine writes its tally. boot-matrix reads it.

testingFlags.name: LC_HVDBT_KERNEL
testingFlags.meaning: Where to dump the guest kernel.

testingFlags.name: LC_HVDBT_RAM
testingFlags.meaning: Where to dump guest RAM at shutdown or reset.

testingFlags.name: LC_HVDBT_SCREEN
testingFlags.meaning: Where to dump the guest's screen.

testingFlags.name: LC_HVDBT_NO_DIRECT
testingFlags.meaning: Don't register the engine's direct memory listener.

testingFlags.name: VIM_DISPLAY_TIMING
testingFlags.meaning: Log the installer display's timing.

testingFlags.name: VIM_HVF_IO_LATENCY_PORT
testingFlags.meaning: HVF: the I/O port whose exit latency to time.

testingFlags.name: VIM_HVF_IO_LATENCY_MASK
testingFlags.meaning: HVF: widens the timed port to a range. Requires VIM_HVF_IO_LATENCY_PORT.

testingFlags.name: VIM_OPENGL_RENDERER_PID
testingFlags.meaning: An external OpenGL renderer's process, authenticated instead of the in-process library.

testingFlags.name: PVG_CAPTURE_LIBRARIES
testingFlags.meaning: A folder to save submitted Metal libraries in.

testingFlags.name: PVG_HVF_FAST_CPUID0
testingFlags.meaning: HVF: answer CPUID leaf 0 without the device-model lock. A Mojave experiment.

testingFlags.name: PVG_INTEL_PAGE_WALKER
testingFlags.meaning: Install the Intel page-table iterator hook.

testingFlags.name: PVG_LEGACY_SHADOW
testingFlags.default: on in the helper, which sets it
testingFlags.meaning: Install the legacy shadow.

testingFlags.name: PVG_SHADOW_PRIVATE_PAGING
testingFlags.default: on in the helper, which sets it
testingFlags.meaning: Hook private buffer paging in the legacy shadow.

testingFlags.name: PVG_NATIVE_INTEL_GEOMETRY
testingFlags.meaning: The local ARM26 donor's Intel geometry experiment.

testingFlags.name: PVG_OOP_CHECK_HELPER
testingFlags.meaning: With PVG_OOP_CHECK_RAM, a helper to try bootstrapping.

testingFlags.name: PVG_OOP_CHECK_MAPPINGS
testingFlags.meaning: Have the helper check its guest RAM mappings.

testingFlags.name: PVG_OOP_CHECK_RAM
testingFlags.meaning: Check that guest RAM can be shared with the helper.

testingFlags.name: PVG_OOP_TIMING
testingFlags.meaning: Time the helper's frames and acknowledgements.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TEST_SKIP_MSAA_UPLOAD
testingFlags.meaning: Skip multisample uploads. Never a production fix.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TRACE_PAGING
testingFlags.meaning: Trace PVG's paging.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TRACE_UI
testingFlags.meaning: Trace the Cocoa UI's view sizes.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_EVENTS
testingFlags.meaning: Where TCG writes its event counts. guest-bench sets it.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_LOOKUP_DIAGNOSTICS
testingFlags.meaning: Count TB lookups.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_TSO
testingFlags.meaning: Run MTTCG threads under the host's hardware TSO.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_NATIVE_FP_FLAGS
testingFlags.meaning: Use AArch64's FP flags for softfloat's.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_DISPATCH_ACQUIRE
testingFlags.meaning: Add an acquire barrier to inline dispatch.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_SHARED_DISPATCH
testingFlags.meaning: Share one out-of-line dispatch sequence.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_TAIL_DISPATCH
testingFlags.meaning: Dispatch through a tail routine. Apple silicon only.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_HASHED_TLB
testingFlags.meaning: The hashed softmmu TLB experiment. arm64 only.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_TB_ALIGN
testingFlags.meaning: Translation block alignment: native, 32 or 64. Apple silicon only.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_TLB_FLOOR_BITS
testingFlags.meaning: The dynamic TLB's smallest size in bits, 6 to 14. arm64 only.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_TLB_FLOOR_MASK
testingFlags.meaning: The MMU modes the TLB floor applies to. arm64 only.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_ALTERNATE_LOOKUP
testingFlags.meaning: The jump cache's alternate entries.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_BULK_REP
testingFlags.meaning: Bulk REP string operations.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_CHAIN_SYS_RETURN
testingFlags.meaning: Chain translation blocks across system returns.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_CONTEXT_JMP_CACHE
testingFlags.meaning: Keep jump caches per address-space context.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_DISPATCH_RELAXED
testingFlags.meaning: Relaxed loads in inline dispatch.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_FAST_PTW
testingFlags.meaning: The fast x86 page-table walk.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_INLINE_FP
testingFlags.meaning: Inline scalar floating point.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_INLINE_JMP_CACHE
testingFlags.meaning: Inline jump cache lookups.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_INLINE_JMP_CACHE_32
testingFlags.meaning: Inline jump cache lookups for 32-bit code.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_INLINE_JMP_CACHE_CPL0
testingFlags.meaning: Inline jump cache lookups in the kernel.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_INLINE_SSE_PACKED
testingFlags.meaning: Inline packed SSE.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_INLINE_TRIM
testingFlags.meaning: Trim the inline dispatch sequence, except while logging TBs.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_KEEP_PHYS_TLB
testingFlags.meaning: Keep the physical MMU index's TLB entries across CR3 writes.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_LAZY_JMP_CACHE
testingFlags.meaning: Flush the jump cache lazily.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_NATIVE_EXACT_FP
testingFlags.meaning: Native floating point where results are exact.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_NATIVE_PACKED_FP
testingFlags.meaning: Native packed floating point.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_PCID_CONTEXTS
testingFlags.meaning: Keep translations per PCID.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_RET_MISS_TAIL
testingFlags.meaning: A tail routine for return-stack misses.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_RET_STACK
testingFlags.meaning: Predict returns with a return stack.

testingFlags.name: PVG_TCG_SSE_DIRECT_LOAD
testingFlags.meaning: Direct SSE loads.

testingFlags.name: VIM_PVG_EXACT_RUNS
testingFlags.meaning: Build shadow runs from the exact pages used.

testingFlags.name: VIM_PVG_GATHER
testingFlags.meaning: Gather shadow uploads through RAM windows.

testingFlags.name: VIM_PVG_POSTED_MMIO
testingFlags.meaning: Post allow-listed MMIO writes to PVG without waiting.

testingFlags.name: VIM_PVG_SCATTER
testingFlags.meaning: Scatter shadow downloads through RAM windows.

testingFlags.name: VIM_PVG_SLAB
testingFlags.meaning: Keep shadow baselines in a slab.

testingFlags.name: VIM_PVG_TIMING
testingFlags.meaning: Print PVG timing lines, at most every 5 s per metric.

testingFlags.name: VIM_SEAMLESS_PVG_DIR
testingFlags.meaning: Research, for seamless: directory of the per-window PVG surface files, including nodisplay.

testingFlags.name: VIM_SEAMLESS_PVG_SERVICE
testingFlags.meaning: Research, for seamless: Mach service that receives per-window PVG surfaces.

testingFlags.name: VIM_SEAMLESS_PVG_SAMPLED
testingFlags.meaning: Research, for seamless: log how sampled textures are backed, for sizing the layer-tree work.
